'''Hahz Fallone''' was a minor [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] who operated out of [[Iritsa]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chazwa/Legends|Chazwa]]. He was a rival to [[Jorga Sune]], who felt that Hahz had betrayed him on an earlier raid on the planet [[Eckless]]. This raid also caused him to be a wanted man on Eckless and he was hunted down after ten years by [[Rusha]]. He used a group of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] to set up Sune with a fake artifact that led to his death.

He wore the real [[Black Sphere]] on a gold chain around his neck.
